notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1417751_salem_express.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On her starboard side in about 30-32 m off Safaga, largely intact: the white hull and tall superstructure, the bow visor shut, the two funnels side by side with their big S, lifeboats on the sand beside her. A grave (officially 470 died): divers are asked not to enter her. The heading (not published here: 0) is approximate. model_built.glb: the ferry as she was in 1991. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
